decisions.label: Creature speed ×
decisions.note: Every creature's movement speed in a fight times this (difficulty.creatureSpeed; Ed, 2026-11-03: "Animals +20% speed", 1.2): its run, sprint and chase at her, a heavy's top speed, charges, swoops, a legend's charge, a besieger's march. Her speed, shots, lunges and leaps as they were. 1: as before. Live.

decisions.label: Ranged range ×
decisions.note: Every ranged attack's reach times this (difficulty.rangedRange; Ed, 2026-11-03: "ranged attacks have +20% range", 1.2): a shot, a lob or a beam is cast from and flies that much further, at her on top of dodge.b.range. Melee attacks and pulses round a creature as they were. 1: as before. Live.

decisions.label: Adult strength ×
decisions.note: An adult's health (a full 💌 ring's worth of blows) and damage in a fight times this, hers and the wild's alike (difficulty.adultStrength; Ed, 2026-11-03: "adults are stronger", 1.3). Young, babies and legends as they were. 1: as before. Live.

decisions.label: Pack growth curve
decisions.note: The swarm's size curve's power (population.swarm.curve: n = 1 + 11·p^curve; Ed, 2026-11-03: "The curve gets steeper (1.3 → 0.8) so packs grow sooner"). Lower: bigger packs sooner along each island. A new map: it reloads.

decisions.label: Largest island (areas)
decisions.note: An island this many areas or more reaches full packs at its last area; a smaller one its size over this of the way along the curve (population.swarm.largestIsland; Ed, 2026-11-03: "only the largest islands reach full packs"; 50, the phase-5 islands). Lower: smaller islands reach fuller packs. A new map: it reloads.

decisions.label: Spark at 100 bpm (m/s)
decisions.note: The spark's speed at 100 bpm (leyLines.pulseAt100; Ed, 2026-11-03: "a smooth increase from 100 bpm 1.0 m/s to 200 bpm 5.0 m/s", "I think it should be linear"): a straight line runs through it and the 200 bpm speed, on past both (never under 0.2 m/s), by the party's tempo (her record and her knockdowns), times the Waves slider. Live.

decisions.label: Spark at 200 bpm (m/s)
decisions.note: The spark's speed at 200 bpm (leyLines.pulseAt200, 5 as Ed asked), the line's other end: with 1 and 5, 1.8 m/s at 120 bpm and 3 at 150. Live.
